correctness.rationale: For base twelve width four, K=1727(d-a)+132(c-b) on sorted digits; 77 states (u,v) with 1<=u<=11, 0<=v<=u. J(u,v) is injective on these pairs. The actual 77-row gap_table.csv lists every graph arrow and hitting distance and certifies exactly one 3-cycle and one 6-cycle; the fibre formula W(u,v)=(12-u)*[4(3u-1) if v=0, 6 if v=u, 24(u-v) otherwise] counts all padded strings, with one cycle-member correction for t=0. Independent enumeration of all 12^4=20736 padded strings confirms nonzero basin sizes 4712 and 16012, both complete entry-time histograms, sharp h=7 and the separate twelve repdigits mapping to zero. This finite proof is exhaustive.
